description: Search organizations in Zendesk by external ID or name. Returns an array of organizations matching the provided criteria. Use when you need to find specific organizations by their identifier or name. An empty organizations array with count=0 means no matches found. Multiple organizations may share similar names — verify the correct organization via external_id or domain_names before proceeding with operations.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for searching Zendesk organizations.

external_id.description: The external id of an organization to search for. Case-insensitive external identifier for linking to external records.
external_id.title: External Id

name.description: The name of an organization to search for. Supports exact and partial matching.
name.title: Name

inputSchema.title: SearchZendeskOrganizationsRequest

name: search_zendesk_organizations

SearchZendeskOrganizationsResponse.description: Response model for searched Zendesk organizations.

count.description: Total number of organizations matching the query
count.title: Count

next_page.description: URL for the next page of results (null if no more pages)
next_page.title: Next Page

previous_page.description: URL for the previous page of results (null if first page)
previous_page.title: Previous Page

SearchZendeskOrganizationsResponse.title: SearchZendeskOrganizationsResponse

domain_names.description: Domain names associated with the organization
domain_names.title: Domain Names

external_id.description: Case-insensitive external identifier for linking to external records
external_id.title: External Id

group_id.description: Group ID for automatic ticket routing
group_id.title: Group Id

organization_fields.description: Custom field values for the organization
organization_fields.title: Organization Fields

shared_comments.description: Whether end users can comment on each other's tickets
shared_comments.title: Shared Comments

shared_tickets.description: Whether end users can view each other's tickets
shared_tickets.title: Shared Tickets

url.description: API endpoint URL for this organization
url.title: Url
